# KAKA'S LIFE — Maison De Parfum

> KAKA'S LIFE is a luxury fragrance brand based in Pakistan, offering authentic eau de parfum collections with nationwide delivery and cash on delivery.

- **Brand Name**: KAKA'S LIFE — Maison De Parfum
- **Tagline**: Wear Your Signature Scent

- **Title**: Founder & CEO, KAKA'S LIFE

## What We Offer

KAKA'S LIFE offers a curated collection of luxury perfumes and fragrances for men, women, and unisex customers across Pakistan. Key highlights:

- 100% authentic fragrances sourced from authorized distributors
- Luxury gift packaging included with every order
- Cash on Delivery (COD) available nationwide
- Online payment accepted via JazzCash, Easypaisa, and Bank Transfer
- Free delivery on orders above Rs. 3,000
- Nationwide shipping to all cities in Pakistan (2–5 business days)
- Collections include: Pour Femme (women), Pour Homme (men), Unisex, Oud Collection, and Gift Sets

## Featured Product (Coming Soon)

- **Aurelia Gold** — A signature golden fragrance with rare bergamot, opulent jasmine, and warm amber. Launching Soon. Price: Rs. 4,500.
